suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as disease complication. Require established ankylosing spondylitis and independently documented osteoporosis/low bone density consistent with the source phenotype. Osteoporosis is a recognized complication, but individual bone loss is multifactorial; do not assume every AS patient develops osteoporosis. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.

suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-3 adds this relationship only as a bounded clinical proposition. Require established ankylosing spondylitis and separately diagnosed uveitis by appropriate ophthalmic evaluation. Do not infer uveitis from HLA-B27 positivity, red eye, ocular pain, or photophobia alone. Preserve alternative infectious, inflammatory, traumatic, and medication-related causes. PMID 23999006 supports uveitis as a common extra-articular manifestation/association in AS populations; it does not by itself establish individual causation. The cited literature supports only this constrained relationship and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
